reports.eyebrow: Real-world RL · MuJoCo as the real world
reports.summary: Three physical changes to a Booster T1, each absorbed by resuming the frozen flow policy's noise prior on data collected outside IsaacSim. From 0/10 episodes at the start to 9–10/10 on all three tasks after 24 rounds (≈ 3.5 h).
